fusions.name: Ungoverned Blow
fusions.desc: Looses raw arcane force at a target up to 4 tiles away, dealing 40 damage, rising to 1.4 times that from the full 4 tiles. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Loose Spark
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt of raw force into the first enemy in its path, dealing 4 damage. It then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Grounded Ward
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 15% and your arcane resistance by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Lent Footing
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
